Project description: Central West Rugby Union will employ a part-time Referee Support and Development Officer to recruit, accredit and mentor new referees. Project description: This initiative strengthens safe junior rugby participation across U8–U12 while accelerating girls rugby growth in regional NSW. It also integrates Sense Rugby, an all-abilities program delivered by Occupational Therapists.

Project Name: Illawarra Friday Night Junior Rugby 7s Expansion

Project description: Expand girls and junior rugby participation by developing a structured coaching pathway. The program will build sustainable coaching capacity and improve participation, retention, and player experience.

NSW Country Match Official Recruitment and Education Program.
This initiative is designed to recruit, educate and accredit Match Officials throughout Rural and Regional NSW, thus servicing our participants and ensuring sustainability beyond 2026. The primary focus will be on recruitment and education of Volunteer Match Officials.

The event celebrates inclusion, strengthens social cohesion, and increases participation through an exciting festival-style competition.

Project: Rugby Competitions For All
Project description:
This project will increase participation by offering rugby to under-represented groups who may feel unable/unsuited to play and who felt excluded.

This project is aimed at women, men over 35, players U85kgs, Western Sydney residents, and all those unable to participate on a Saturday, when rugby has been traditionally offered.
